Name: Treat Your Pet
Author: G3sila
Description:
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Treat your pet with something they like. Be aware, they have their own [/size][/color][color=#93c47d][size=4]preferences[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4] and some stuff are [/size][/color][color=#e69138][size=4]poisonous[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4] to them![/size][/color]

[size=4][color=#D4D4D8][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50721/50721-1786770283-98853217.gif[/img][/color][/size]

[color=#ffd966][size=4]Left-click (configurable) and treat your pet with the food on your hand.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]This mod designs[b] different food preferences[/b] for all kinds (cat, dog, turtle, and other for moded pet species). [/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Treat your pet for an increase (or decrease?!) of friendship, depending on their preferences of food.[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#D4D4D8]- Love + 10[/color][/size]
[size=4][color=#D4D4D8]- Like + 6[/color][/size]
[size=4][color=#D4D4D8]- Dislike -4[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]- Poisonous -6[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8](Image: Reation from left to right, top to bottom: Like, Dislike, Poisonous, Love)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50721/50721-1786769642-2054418640.jpg[/img][/color]

[size=4]This mod also allows you to treat your pet with some food that the farmer cannot eat directly, like the snails, lobsters, etc.. [/size]
[size=4]You can feed each pet 3 times a day, then they will be full. [/size]


If you are really curious, here is the list of food preferences for each kind of pet, but I recommand you to try it out yourself! It's a link to a really long list! 
[spoiler][url=https://github.com/G3SILA/MyStardewValleyMods/blob/main/GesilaCSharpMods/TreatYourPet/Data/PetFoodData.cs]The list of food preferences[/url][/spoiler]

[size=4]If you like this mod, please[color=#ea9999] endorse[/color]! This motivates me a lot :)[/size]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI, and then this mod. [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Put inside Mods folder under Stardew Valley.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- supports PC and mobile[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- supports Generic Mod Configuration Menu (GMCM)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- supports i18n translation[/color]
